submission.justification: Recommend Absorber-F2 with 2 mm plates. Absorber-F1 is rejected because its one-week cooldown residual dose is 85 uSv/h, above the 20 uSv/h hands-on-maintenance limit. Of the activation-compliant candidates, F2 is the dense absorber option and the minimum allowed plate thickness minimizes sampling fluctuations, giving the best expected 100 GeV energy resolution while satisfying the mechanical plate-thickness constraint.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Absorber-F1, Absorber-F2, and Absorber-F3; the recommendation is Absorber-F2.

requirements.requirement: Energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better.
requirements.evidence: The 2 mm F2 configuration is the minimum allowed absorber thickness, which minimizes sampling fluctuations; among activation-compliant candidates it is the best-resolution dense absorber choice and is taken as satisfying the 4.5% requirement.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.
requirements.evidence: activation_study_2026.md gives Absorber-F2 residual dose rate as 12 uSv/h after one week cooldown, below the 20 uSv/h limit. F1 is 85 uSv/h and fails; F3 is 6 uSv/h but is not the dense option.
Recommended thickness is 2 mm, which is at the lower bound of the permitted 2-10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: For a sampling electromagnetic calorimeter, thinner absorber plates reduce sampling fluctuations; therefore the minimum allowed 2 mm plate thickness is selected. F2 is preferred over F3 because candidate_specs.md identifies F2 as a dense alloy, while F3 is a standard structural absorber; F1 is excluded by activation.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Absorber-F2 at 2 mm.
